summary: National Storage Affiliates Trust (NSA) filed an 8-K reporting shareholder votes at a special meeting held July 14, 2026, approving its merger into Pelican Merger Sub I, LLC, a wholly owned direct subsidiary of Public Storage, under an agreement dated March 16, 2026. The merger proposal received 65,683,522 votes for (99.8% of votes cast) with only 58,214 against and 36,915 abstentions, representing ~85% of outstanding common shares. A non-binding compensation proposal also passed. The deal is all-cash, though price per share and premium are not specified in this filing. Per the definitive proxy filed June 12, 2026, the merger is expected to close in 2026 subject to regulatory approvals. Watch for regulatory clearances and final closing conditions; the overwhelming vote indicates minimal risk of shareholder opposition.
